name: Spica Neal
source:
After the events of Ar Tonelico: Melody of Elemia, Spica works as a pharmacist and is shown as a good friend of [url=/c3692]Jacqli[/url]. She still has secret items that become available after a certain amount of events, using the same password. However, she now sells accessories and consumable items at a very high price.

[[url=http://artonelico.wikia.com/wiki/Spica_Neal]From Ar Tonelico Wiki[/url]]
